#!/bin/sh
# Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
# Licensed under the MIT License.

# Sourced by a platform-owned Agent init script, not an Agent entrypoint.
if [ "${1:-}" = "--help" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "Source this library, implement agent_* stages, then call run_agent_init."
fi

init_error() {
  printf '[agent-init] %s\n' "$*" >&2
  return 1
}

check_common_tools() {
  for tool in cp mkdir mv rm chmod mktemp find cmp; do
    command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
      init_error "InitToolsMissing: $tool"
      return 1
    }
  done
}

# Resolve a controlled relative path without following links out of the PVC.
home_path() (
  set -e
  rest=$1
  case "$rest" in ""|/*|*/|*"//"*) init_error "InvalidHomePath"; exit 1;; esac
  result=$TARGET_HOME
  while :; do
    part=${rest%%/*}
    case "$part" in ""|.|..) init_error "InvalidHomePath"; exit 1;; esac
    result=$result/$part
    if [ -L "$result" ]; then
      init_error "HomePathIsSymlink: $1"
      exit 1
    fi
    if [ "$rest" = "$part" ]; then break; fi
    if [ -e "$result" ] && [ ! -d "$result" ]; then
      init_error "HomeParentNotDirectory: $1"
      exit 1
    fi
    rest=${rest#*/}
  done
  printf '%s\n' "$result"
)

home_ensure_dir() (
  set -e
  dest=$(home_path "$1")
  mkdir -p "$dest"
)

home_atomic_copy() (
  set -e
  source=$1
  dest=$(home_path "$2")
  mode=${3:-600}
  [ -f "$source" ] || { init_error "RequiredInputMissing: $2"; exit 1; }
  [ ! -e "$dest" ] || [ -f "$dest" ] || { init_error "HomeTargetNotFile: $2"; exit 1; }
  temp=$(mktemp "${dest}.tmp.XXXXXX")
  trap 'rm -f "$temp"' 0
  cp "$source" "$temp"
  chmod "$mode" "$temp"
  mv -f "$temp" "$dest"
)

home_write_marker() (
  set -e
  dest=$(home_path "$1")
  [ ! -e "$dest" ] || [ -f "$dest" ] || { init_error "InvalidHomeMarker"; exit 1; }
  temp=$(mktemp "${dest}.tmp.XXXXXX")
  trap 'rm -f "$temp"' 0
  shift
  printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$temp"
  chmod 600 "$temp"
  mv -f "$temp" "$dest"
)

immutable_seed_image() {
  case "$CETIRUN_INIT_IMAGE" in
    *@sha256:*)
      digest=${CETIRUN_INIT_IMAGE##*@sha256:}
      [ "${#digest}" -eq 64 ] || return 1
      case "$digest" in *[!0-9a-f]*) return 1;; esac
      ;;
    *) return 1;;
  esac
}

seed_home_data() (
  set -e
  complete=$(home_path .cetirun-home-seeded)
  pending=$(home_path .cetirun-home-seeding)
  if [ -e "$complete" ]; then
    [ -f "$complete" ] || { init_error "InvalidHomeMarker"; exit 1; }
    IFS= read -r version < "$complete"
    [ "$version" = seeded-v1 ] || { init_error "InvalidHomeMarker"; exit 1; }
    printf '0\n'
    exit 0
  fi

  if [ -n "${LEGACY_HOME_MARKER:-}" ]; then
    legacy=$(home_path "$LEGACY_HOME_MARKER")
    if [ -f "$legacy" ]; then
      home_write_marker .cetirun-home-seeded seeded-v1 legacy
      printf '0\n'
      exit 0
    fi
  fi

  case "${CETIRUN_INIT_IMAGE:-}" in
    ""|*[[:space:]]*) init_error "InvalidSeedImage"; exit 1;;
  esac
  if [ -e "$pending" ]; then
    [ -f "$pending" ] || { init_error "InvalidHomeProgress"; exit 1; }
    {
      IFS= read -r version
      IFS= read -r prior_image
      IFS= read -r prior_stage
    } < "$pending"
    [ "$version" = seeding-v1 ] && [ "$prior_image" = "$CETIRUN_INIT_IMAGE" ] &&
      immutable_seed_image || {
        init_error "HomeSeedImageUnconfirmed: retry requires the same immutable image"
        exit 1
      }
    case "$prior_stage" in
      */*|*[!a-zA-Z0-9.-]*) init_error "InvalidHomeProgress"; exit 1;;
      .cetirun-home-stage.??????) ;;
      *) init_error "InvalidHomeProgress"; exit 1;;
    esac
    stage=$(home_path "$prior_stage")
    # This is only the recorded disposable copy, never the PVC or a HOME entry.
    if [ -e "$stage" ]; then
      [ -d "$stage" ] || { init_error "InvalidHomeProgress"; exit 1; }
      rm -rf "$stage"
    fi
  else
    for entry in "$TARGET_HOME"/* "$TARGET_HOME"/.[!.]* "$TARGET_HOME"/..?*; do
      [ -e "$entry" ] || [ -L "$entry" ] || continue
      if [ "${entry##*/}" = lost+found ] && [ -d "$entry" ] && [ ! -L "$entry" ]; then
        continue
      fi
      init_error "HomeSeedStateUnknown: nonempty HOME has no initialization record"
      exit 1
    done
  fi

  stage=$(mktemp -d "$TARGET_HOME/.cetirun-home-stage.XXXXXX")
  home_write_marker .cetirun-home-seeding seeding-v1 "$CETIRUN_INIT_IMAGE" "${stage##*/}"
  for entry in "$SOURCE_HOME"/* "$SOURCE_HOME"/.[!.]* "$SOURCE_HOME"/..?*; do
    [ -e "$entry" ] || [ -L "$entry" ] || continue
    name=${entry##*/}
    case "$name" in .cetirun-home-*|lost+found) continue;; esac
    special=$(find "$entry" ! -type d ! -type f ! -type l -print)
    [ -z "$special" ] || { init_error "UnsupportedHomeFile"; exit 1; }
    # Each entry is copied to a fresh location, so existing destination links
    # cannot redirect recursive copying outside the PVC.
    cp -a "$entry" "$stage/$name"
  done
  for entry in "$stage"/* "$stage"/.[!.]* "$stage"/..?*; do
    [ -e "$entry" ] || [ -L "$entry" ] || continue
    dest=$TARGET_HOME/${entry##*/}
    # A previous interrupted publish may already have moved whole top-level
    # entries. Preserve those entries rather than recopying into them.
    if [ ! -e "$dest" ] && [ ! -L "$dest" ]; then
      mv "$entry" "$dest"
    fi
  done
  home_write_marker .cetirun-home-seeded seeded-v1 "$CETIRUN_INIT_IMAGE"
  rm -f "$pending"
  rm -rf "$stage"
  printf '1\n'
)

seed_home_once() {
  HOME_SEEDED_THIS_RUN=$(seed_home_data)
}

check_agent_context() {
  if [ -n "${CETIRUN_MEMORY_ASSETS:-}" ]; then
    [ "$CETIRUN_MEMORY_ASSETS" = /opt/cetirun-memory ] &&
      [ -r "$CETIRUN_MEMORY_ASSETS/manifest.json" ] &&
      [ -r "$CETIRUN_MEMORY_ASSETS/AGENTS.md" ] &&
      [ -r "$CETIRUN_MEMORY_ASSETS/skills/cetirun-memory/SKILL.md" ] || {
        init_error "MemoryAssetsUnavailable"
        return 1
      }
  fi
  if [ -n "${CETIRUN_SHARED_SKILLS_DIR:-}" ]; then
    [ -d "$CETIRUN_SHARED_SKILLS_DIR" ] && [ -r "$CETIRUN_SHARED_SKILLS_DIR" ] &&
      [ -x "$CETIRUN_SHARED_SKILLS_DIR" ] || {
        init_error "SharedSkillsUnavailable"
        return 1
      }
  fi
  if [ -n "${CETIRUN_MEMORY_ASSETS:-}" ] || [ -n "${CETIRUN_SHARED_SKILLS_DIR:-}" ]; then
    [ -n "${CETIRUN_CONTEXT_VIEW:-}" ] && [ -d "$CETIRUN_CONTEXT_VIEW" ] &&
      [ ! -L "$CETIRUN_CONTEXT_VIEW" ] && [ -w "$CETIRUN_CONTEXT_VIEW" ] || {
        init_error "ContextViewUnavailable"
        return 1
      }
  fi
}

# Compose one per-Pod view before mounting it read-only at $HOME/.agents.
# Sources and the PVC's own .agents contents are never modified.
prepare_agent_context() (
  set -e
  [ -n "${CETIRUN_CONTEXT_VIEW:-}" ] || exit 0
  home_ensure_dir .agents
  view=$CETIRUN_CONTEXT_VIEW
  [ ! -L "$view/current" ] || { init_error "InvalidContextView"; exit 1; }
  [ ! -e "$view/current" ] || {
    [ -f "$view/current/.ready" ] || { init_error "IncompleteContextView"; exit 1; }
    exit 0
  }
  stage=$(mktemp -d "$view/.context.XXXXXX")
  trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' 0
  mkdir "$stage/skills"
  if [ -n "${CETIRUN_CONTEXT_DIR:-}" ]; then
    # Only the platform ConfigMap projection may use Kubernetes-owned links.
    cp -RL "$CETIRUN_CONTEXT_DIR/AGENTS.md" "$stage/AGENTS.md"
    for entry in "$CETIRUN_CONTEXT_DIR/skills"/* "$CETIRUN_CONTEXT_DIR/skills"/.[!.]* "$CETIRUN_CONTEXT_DIR/skills"/..?*; do
      [ -e "$entry" ] || [ -L "$entry" ] || continue
      if [ -n "${CETIRUN_MEMORY_ASSETS:-}" ] && [ "${entry##*/}" = cetirun-memory ]; then continue; fi
      cp -RL "$entry" "$stage/skills/${entry##*/}"
    done
  else
    : > "$stage/AGENTS.md"
  fi
  if [ -n "${CETIRUN_MEMORY_ASSETS:-}" ]; then
    chmod u+w "$stage/AGENTS.md"
    if [ -s "$stage/AGENTS.md" ]; then printf '\n' >> "$stage/AGENTS.md"; fi
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
      printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$stage/AGENTS.md"
    done < "$CETIRUN_MEMORY_ASSETS/AGENTS.md"
    cp -R "$CETIRUN_MEMORY_ASSETS/skills/cetirun-memory" "$stage/skills/cetirun-memory"
  fi
  if [ -n "${CETIRUN_SHARED_SKILLS_DIR:-}" ]; then
    for entry in "$CETIRUN_SHARED_SKILLS_DIR"/* "$CETIRUN_SHARED_SKILLS_DIR"/.[!.]* "$CETIRUN_SHARED_SKILLS_DIR"/..?*; do
      [ -e "$entry" ] || [ -L "$entry" ] || continue
      name=${entry##*/}
      if [ "$name" = cetirun-memory ] || [ -e "$stage/skills/$name" ] || [ -L "$stage/skills/$name" ]; then
        init_error "SharedSkillConflictsWithCanonicalContext"
        exit 1
      fi
      special=$(find "$entry" ! -type d ! -type f ! -type l -print)
      [ -z "$special" ] || { init_error "UnsupportedSkillFile"; exit 1; }
      cp -RP "$entry" "$stage/skills/$name"
    done
  fi
  printf 'context-v1\n' > "$stage/.ready"
  mv "$stage" "$view/current"
)

run_agent_init() {
  set -e
  check_common_tools
  : "${SOURCE_HOME:?SOURCE_HOME is required}"
  : "${TARGET_HOME:?TARGET_HOME is required}"
  [ -d "$SOURCE_HOME" ] && [ -d "$TARGET_HOME" ] &&
    [ ! -L "$SOURCE_HOME" ] && [ ! -L "$TARGET_HOME" ] || {
      init_error "HomeDirectoryUnavailable"
      return 1
    }
  SOURCE_HOME=$(CDPATH= cd -P "$SOURCE_HOME" && pwd -P)
  TARGET_HOME=$(CDPATH= cd -P "$TARGET_HOME" && pwd -P)
  case "$SOURCE_HOME:$TARGET_HOME" in /:*|*:/) init_error "InvalidHomeRoot"; return 1;; esac
  case "$SOURCE_HOME/" in "$TARGET_HOME/"*) init_error "OverlappingHomePaths"; return 1;; esac
  case "$TARGET_HOME/" in "$SOURCE_HOME/"*) init_error "OverlappingHomePaths"; return 1;; esac
  for stage in agent_check_requirements agent_prepare_home agent_apply_config agent_prepare_integrations agent_verify; do
    command -v "$stage" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { init_error "InitStageMissing: $stage"; return 1; }
  done
  agent_check_requirements
  check_agent_context
  printf '[agent-init] seed_home_once\n' >&2
  seed_home_once
  for stage in agent_prepare_home agent_apply_config agent_prepare_integrations prepare_agent_context agent_verify; do
    printf '[agent-init] %s\n' "$stage" >&2
    "$stage"
  done
  printf '[agent-init] complete\n' >&2
}

#!/bin/sh
# Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
# Licensed under the MIT License.

set -e
if [ "${1:-}" = "--help" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "Initialize an OpenClaw HOME using SOURCE_HOME, TARGET_HOME and CETIRUN_INIT_IMAGE."
  exit 0
fi
SOURCE_HOME=${SOURCE_HOME:-/home/vibe}
TARGET_HOME=${TARGET_HOME:-/home-data}
RUNTIME_HOME=${RUNTIME_HOME:-/home/vibe}
CETIRUN_CONFIG_DIR=${CETIRUN_CONFIG_DIR:-/etc/cetirun}
CETIRUN_BUILTIN_SKILL_SYNC=${CETIRUN_BUILTIN_SKILL_SYNC:-/usr/local/share/cetirun/builtin-skill-sync.sh}
LEGACY_HOME_MARKER=.openclaw/.initialized
. "$CETIRUN_CONFIG_DIR/init-home-common.sh"

agent_check_requirements() {
  for tool in jq ln readlink; do
    command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { init_error "InitToolsMissing: $tool"; return 1; }
  done
  [ -f "$CETIRUN_CONFIG_DIR/openclaw.json" ] || {
    init_error "OpenClawInputMissing"
    return 1
  }
  [ -f "$CETIRUN_BUILTIN_SKILL_SYNC" ] || {
    init_error "OpenClawInputMissing: builtin-skill-sync.sh"
    return 1
  }
  if [ "${CETIRUN_NATIVE_SANDBOX:-false}" = true ] &&
    [ "${CETIRUN_AI_GATEWAY:-false}" != true ]; then
    init_error "NativeSandboxRequiresAIGateway"
    return 1
  fi
}

agent_prepare_home() {
  for directory in .openclaw .openclaw/logs .openclaw/workspace .acpx .local/bin; do
    home_ensure_dir "$directory"
  done
  native_marker=$(home_path "$LEGACY_HOME_MARKER")
  user_file=$(home_path .openclaw/workspace/USER.md)
  # Resume first native initialization even when HOME has already been copied.
  if [ -f "$CETIRUN_CONFIG_DIR/user-md" ] && [ ! -f "$native_marker" ]; then
    if [ ! -e "$user_file" ] ||
      { [ -f "$SOURCE_HOME/.openclaw/workspace/USER.md" ] &&
        cmp -s "$user_file" "$SOURCE_HOME/.openclaw/workspace/USER.md"; }; then
      home_atomic_copy "$CETIRUN_CONFIG_DIR/user-md" .openclaw/workspace/USER.md 600
    fi
  fi
}

agent_apply_config() (
  set -e
  dest=$(home_path .openclaw/openclaw.json)
  source=$CETIRUN_CONFIG_DIR/openclaw.json
  jq -e 'type == "object"' "$source" >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
    { init_error "OpenClawConfigInvalid"; exit 1; }
  if [ -e "$dest" ]; then
    [ -f "$dest" ] && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$dest" >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
      { init_error "OpenClawConfigInvalid: preserving existing configuration"; exit 1; }
  fi
  temp=$(mktemp "${dest}.tmp.XXXXXX")
  trap 'rm -f "$temp"' 0
  # CetiRun owns the model list of an Agent on the platform AI Gateway, which
  # the chart marks with CETIRUN_AI_GATEWAY, so that list replaces the saved
  # one instead of accumulating models the Gateway no longer offers. So does
  # the Gateway provider entry, which binds the Agent's virtual key: a key,
  # auth mode or request override saved on that provider would otherwise be
  # sent to the Gateway in its place. The retired in-agent Copilot sign-in
  # profile is dropped. Any other configuration, other providers and an openai
  # provider with its own endpoint included, keeps its saved settings on the
  # legacy path. Native Sandbox model and ingress bindings are platform-owned.
  if [ "${CETIRUN_AI_GATEWAY:-false}" = true ]; then
    gateway=true
  else
    gateway=false
  fi
  native_gateway=false
  if [ "${CETIRUN_NATIVE_SANDBOX:-false}" = true ]; then
    native_gateway=true
    jq -e '
      (.models.providers | keys) == ["openai"]
      and .auth == {"profiles": {}}
      and .models.providers.openai.apiKey == {"source": "env", "provider": "default", "id": "OPENAI_API_KEY"}
      and (.models.providers.openai.baseUrl | type == "string" and length > 0)
      and (.agents.defaults.model.primary as $primary | .agents.defaults.models | has($primary))
      and ((.agents.list // []) | length == 0)
    ' "$source" >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
      { init_error "OpenClawNativeModelConfigInvalid"; exit 1; }
  fi
  filter='
    . as $inputs
    | .[-1] as $source
    | reduce .[] as $item ({}; . * $item)
    | reduce [["plugins", "load", "paths"], ["skills", "load", "extraDirs"]][] as $path
        (. ; [$inputs[] | getpath($path) | select(. != null)] as $lists
          | if ($lists | length) == 0 then .
            elif all($lists[]; type == "array" and all(.[]; type == "string")) then
              setpath($path; reduce ($lists | add)[] as $entry ([]; if index($entry) == null then . + [$entry] else . end))
            else error("invalid plugin or skills list") end)
    | if $source.plugins.entries["cetirun-memory-context"].enabled != true then
        if (.plugins.entries | type) == "object" then .plugins.entries |= del(.["cetirun-memory-context"]) else . end
        | if (.plugins.allow | type) == "array" then .plugins.allow |= map(select(. != "cetirun-memory-context")) else . end
        | if (.plugins.load.paths | type) == "array" then .plugins.load.paths |= map(select(. != "/opt/cetirun-memory/adapters/openclaw")) else . end
        | if (.skills.load.extraDirs | type) == "array" and (($source.skills.load.extraDirs // []) | index("/home/vibe/.agents/skills") | not)
          then .skills.load.extraDirs |= map(select(. != "/home/vibe/.agents/skills")) else . end
      else . end
    | if $gateway then
        .agents.defaults.models = ($source.agents.defaults.models // {})
        | if $native_gateway then
            .models = ($source.models // {})
            | .auth = ($source.auth // {"profiles": {}})
            | .gateway = ($source.gateway // {})
            | .agents.defaults.model = $source.agents.defaults.model
            | .agents.defaults.modelPolicy = $source.agents.defaults.modelPolicy
            | .agents.defaults.utilityModel = $source.agents.defaults.utilityModel
            | .agents |= del(.list)
          else
            if ($source.models.providers.openai | type) == "object" then .models.providers.openai = $source.models.providers.openai else . end
            | if (.auth.profiles | type) == "object" then .auth.profiles |= del(.["github-copilot:github"]) else . end
          end
      else . end
    | if .channels.msteams.enabled then
        .channels.msteams.allowFrom //= ["00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"]
      else . end'
  if [ -f "$dest" ]; then
    jq -s --argjson gateway "$gateway" --argjson native_gateway "$native_gateway" "$filter" "$dest" "$source" > "$temp" 2>/dev/null ||
      { init_error "OpenClawConfigApplyFailed"; exit 1; }
  else
    jq -s --argjson gateway "$gateway" --argjson native_gateway "$native_gateway" "$filter" "$source" > "$temp" 2>/dev/null ||
      { init_error "OpenClawConfigApplyFailed"; exit 1; }
  fi
  chmod 600 "$temp"
  mv -f "$temp" "$dest"
  health_record=$(home_path .openclaw/logs/config-health.json)
  if [ -f "$health_record" ]; then rm -f "$health_record"; fi
)

remove_native_provider_environment() (
  set -e
  [ "${CETIRUN_NATIVE_SANDBOX:-false}" = true ] || exit 0
  env_file=$(home_path .openclaw/.env)
  [ ! -e "$env_file" ] || [ -f "$env_file" ] ||
    { init_error "OpenClawEnvironmentInvalid"; exit 1; }
  [ -f "$env_file" ] || exit 0
  temp=$(mktemp "${env_file}.tmp.XXXXXX")
  trap 'rm -f "$temp"' 0
  # Persisted dotenv settings must not replace the native Gateway binding.
  keys='(OPENAI_.*|ANTHROPIC_.*|AZURE_OPENAI_.*|AZURE_AI_.*|COHERE_.*|DEEPSEEK_.*|FIREWORKS_.*|GEMINI_.*|GOOGLE_AI_.*|GROQ_.*|HUGGINGFACE_.*|MISTRAL_.*|OLLAMA_.*|OPENROUTER_.*|PERPLEXITY_.*|TOGETHER_.*|VERTEX_AI_.*|XAI_.*|MODEL_API_KEY|LLM_API_KEY|LLM_BASE_URL|LLM_ENDPOINT|COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN|OPENCLAW_GITHUB_TOKEN)'
  result=0
  grep -Ev "^[[:space:]]*(export[[:space:]]+)?${keys}[[:space:]]*=" "$env_file" > "$temp" || result=$?
  [ "$result" -le 1 ] || { init_error "OpenClawEnvironmentApplyFailed"; exit 1; }
  chmod 600 "$temp"
  mv -f "$temp" "$env_file"
)

prepare_plugin_link() {
  source=$SOURCE_HOME/.openclaw/npm
  parent=$(home_path .openclaw)
  dest=$parent/npm
  if [ -L "$source" ]; then
    link=$(readlink "$source")
    if [ -L "$dest" ]; then
      if [ "$(readlink "$dest")" != "$link" ]; then
        init_error "OpenClawPluginLinkChanged: explicit maintenance required"
        return 1
      fi
    elif [ -e "$dest" ]; then
      printf '[agent-init] preserving existing OpenClaw plugin directory\n' >&2
    else
      ln -s "$link" "$dest"
    fi
  fi
}

install_image_skills() (
  set -e
  source=$SOURCE_HOME/.openclaw/skills
  [ -d "$source" ] && [ ! -L "$source" ] || exit 0
  home_ensure_dir .openclaw/skills
  for entry in "$source"/*; do
    [ -d "$entry" ] && [ ! -L "$entry" ] || continue
    dest=$(home_path ".openclaw/skills/${entry##*/}")
    [ ! -e "$dest" ] || continue
    stage=$(mktemp -d "$TARGET_HOME/.openclaw/skills/.install.XXXXXX")
    trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' 0
    cp -a "$entry" "$stage/skill"
    mv "$stage/skill" "$dest"
    rm -rf "$stage"
  done
)

sync_managed_image_skills() {
  . "$CETIRUN_BUILTIN_SKILL_SYNC"
  cetirun_sync_builtin_skills \
    "$SOURCE_HOME/.openclaw/skills" \
    "$(home_path .openclaw/skills)"
}

setup_azdevops_git_credential() (
  set -e
  [ "${AZDEVOPS_GIT_CREDENTIAL_ENABLED:-false}" = true ] || exit 0
  helper=$(home_path .git-credential-azdevops.sh)
  config=$(home_path .gitconfig)
  temp=$(mktemp "${helper}.tmp.XXXXXX")
  trap 'rm -f "$temp"' 0
  cat > "$temp" <<'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
echo "username=azuredevops"
echo "password=$(az account get-access-token --resource 499b84ac-1321-427f-aa17-267ca6975798 --query accessToken -o tsv)"
SCRIPT
  chmod 700 "$temp"
  mv -f "$temp" "$helper"
  # Installation does not perform login. Optional git settings remain best-effort.
  if ! git config --file "$config" credential.https://dev.azure.com.useHttpPath true; then
    printf '[agent-init] WARNING: Azure DevOps git useHttpPath configuration failed\n' >&2
  fi
  if ! git config --file "$config" credential.https://dev.azure.com.provider generic; then
    printf '[agent-init] WARNING: Azure DevOps git provider configuration failed\n' >&2
  fi
  if ! git config --file "$config" credential.https://dev.azure.com.helper "$RUNTIME_HOME/.git-credential-azdevops.sh"; then
    printf '[agent-init] WARNING: Azure DevOps git helper configuration failed\n' >&2
  fi
)

agent_prepare_integrations() {
  remove_native_provider_environment
  prepare_plugin_link
  sync_managed_image_skills
  install_image_skills
  remove_retired_copilot_helper
  setup_azdevops_git_credential
}

# Models come through the platform AI Gateway, and GitHub Copilot sign-in
# moved to the Portal. Remove the retired in-agent helper earlier releases
# installed, so it does not suggest a login that no longer applies.
remove_retired_copilot_helper() {
  helper=$(home_path .local/bin/copilot-auth)
  if [ -f "$helper" ] && [ ! -L "$helper" ] && grep -q 'Authenticate GitHub Copilot for OpenClaw' "$helper"; then
    rm -f "$helper"
  fi
}

agent_verify() {
  config=$(home_path .openclaw/openclaw.json)
  jq -e 'type == "object"' "$config" >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
    { init_error "OpenClawConfigInvalid"; return 1; }
  home_write_marker "$LEGACY_HOME_MARKER" initialized-v1
}

run_agent_init

#!/bin/sh
# Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
# Licensed under the MIT License.

# init-skills.sh — install npm-packaged skills into the PVC.
#
# Environment:
#   NPM_PACKAGES   space-separated list of npm package specs (e.g. "matrix @scope/foo@1.2.3")
#   SKILLS_DIR     target directory on the PVC (e.g. /home-data/.cetirun/skills/npm)
#   NPM_CACHE_DIR  working directory + npm cache root on the PVC
#   NPM_REGISTRY   package registry; defaults to the public npm registry
#
# Behavior:
#   - For each package, install into NPM_CACHE_DIR/<dir>/, then copy
#     node_modules/<pkg-name>/ to SKILLS_DIR/<dir>/.
#   - Idempotent: <dir>/.installed-version stores the requested spec; skipped if matches.
#   - Prunes <dir> entries no longer in the requested list.
#   - Per-package failures are recorded; script exits non-zero if any failed.
set -u

: "${NPM_PACKAGES:=}"
: "${SKILLS_DIR:=/home-data/.cetirun/skills/npm}"
: "${NPM_CACHE_DIR:=/home-data/.cetirun/.npm-cache}"
: "${NPM_REGISTRY:=https://registry.npmjs.org/}"

if [ -n "$NPM_REGISTRY" ]; then
  export npm_config_registry="$NPM_REGISTRY"
  # Rewrite lockfile-style npmjs URLs but preserve mirror-owned tarball URLs.
  export npm_config_replace_registry_host=npmjs
fi

ERRORS_LOG="${SKILLS_DIR}/.errors.log"

mkdir -p "$SKILLS_DIR" "$NPM_CACHE_DIR"
: > "$ERRORS_LOG"

# Sanitize a package spec into a directory name:
#   "@scope/name@1.2.3" -> "@scope__name"
#   "matrix"            -> "matrix"
sanitize() {
  spec="$1"
  # If spec starts with @, version is after the SECOND @; else after first.
  case "$spec" in
    @*)
      name="@$(printf %s "$spec" | cut -c2- | cut -d@ -f1)"
      ;;
    *)
      name="$(printf %s "$spec" | cut -d@ -f1)"
      ;;
  esac
  printf %s "$name" | sed 's|/|__|g'
}

# Extract the package name (without version) so we can copy from node_modules/<name>/.
pkg_name() {
  spec="$1"
  case "$spec" in
    @*)
      printf '@%s\n' "$(printf %s "$spec" | cut -c2- | cut -d@ -f1)"
      ;;
    *)
      printf '%s\n' "$(printf %s "$spec" | cut -d@ -f1)"
      ;;
  esac
}

keep_list=""
fail_count=0

for spec in $NPM_PACKAGES; do
  [ -n "$spec" ] || continue
  case "$spec" in
    -*)
      echo "[init-skills] FAILED $spec — package spec must not start with '-'" | tee -a "$ERRORS_LOG"
      fail_count=$((fail_count + 1))
      continue
      ;;
  esac
  dir=$(sanitize "$spec")
  name=$(pkg_name "$spec")
  keep_list="$keep_list $dir"

  target="$SKILLS_DIR/$dir"
  marker="$target/.installed-version"

  if [ -f "$marker" ] && [ "$(cat "$marker" 2>/dev/null)" = "$spec" ]; then
    echo "[init-skills] $spec — up to date (skip)"
    continue
  fi

  echo "[init-skills] installing $spec → $target"
  work="$NPM_CACHE_DIR/$dir"
  rm -rf "$work"
  mkdir -p "$work"
  (
    cd "$work" || exit 1
    # --prefix . installs into ./node_modules; --no-save avoids requiring package.json.
    npm install \
      --prefix . \
      --no-save \
      --omit=dev \
      --no-audit \
      --no-fund \
      --cache "$NPM_CACHE_DIR/_npm" \
      "$spec"
  )
  rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "[init-skills] FAILED npm install $spec (exit $rc)" | tee -a "$ERRORS_LOG"
    fail_count=$((fail_count + 1))
    continue
  fi

  src="$work/node_modules/$name"
  if [ ! -d "$src" ]; then
    echo "[init-skills] FAILED $spec — $src not found after install" | tee -a "$ERRORS_LOG"
    fail_count=$((fail_count + 1))
    continue
  fi

  rm -rf "$target"
  mkdir -p "$target"
  # cp -a preserves attrs; trailing /. copies dir contents into target.
  cp -a "$src/." "$target/"
  printf '%s\n' "$spec" > "$marker"
  echo "[init-skills] OK $spec"
done

# Prune entries that are no longer requested.
if [ -d "$SKILLS_DIR" ]; then
  for existing in "$SKILLS_DIR"/*; do
    [ -d "$existing" ] || continue
    base=$(basename "$existing")
    case " $keep_list " in
      *" $base "*) ;;
      *)
        echo "[init-skills] pruning $existing (no longer requested)"
        rm -rf "$existing"
        ;;
    esac
  done
fi

if [ "$fail_count" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "[init-skills] $fail_count package(s) failed; see $ERRORS_LOG" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "[init-skills] done."

#!/bin/sh
# Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
# Licensed under the MIT License.

# Retire the GitHub Copilot sign-in the in-agent helper made, for an Agent
# that takes its models from the platform AI Gateway: its owner signs in
# through the Portal, and that token stays with the Agent's Copilot proxy.
# The helper left the GitHub token in the home, where the agent can read it:
# in the github-copilot:github auth profile, in the secret-store entries the
# device login keeps it in, in the state directory's .env, and in the auth
# profile files of earlier OpenClaw versions. This removes those through
# OpenClaw's own interface where it has one, once per home, after doctor has
# imported any earlier auth profile files, and keeps every other credential.
# A step that fails is reported with OpenClaw's reason and tried again at the
# next start. It does not keep the agent from starting: an init container
# that keeps failing keeps the Agent down, and its StatefulSet then rolls no
# corrected chart onto the Pod until someone deletes the Pod.
set -u
if [ "${1:-}" = "--help" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "Remove the in-agent GitHub Copilot sign-in from an OpenClaw state directory, once."
  exit 0
fi

state=${OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR:-$HOME/.openclaw}
marker=$state/.cetirun-copilot-sign-in-retired
profile=github-copilot:github
store_prefix=GITHUB_COPILOT_TOKEN
env_keys='^[[:space:]]*(export[[:space:]]+)?(COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN|OPENCLAW_GITHUB_TOKEN)='

[ -d "$state" ] || exit 0
[ -f "$marker" ] && exit 0

log() {
  printf 'retire-copilot-sign-in: %s\n' "$*" >&2
}

if ! scratch=$(mktemp -d); then
  log "could not create a scratch directory; the next start tries again"
  exit 0
fi
trap 'rm -rf "$scratch"' EXIT
output=$scratch/output
errors=$scratch/errors
: >"$output"
: >"$errors"
# The OpenClaw CLI resolves the secrets the Agent's configuration refers to,
# which only the agent container's environment holds, and fails without
# them. The auth profiles and the secret store live in the state directory:
# give the CLI a configuration of its own.
export OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH="$scratch/openclaw.json"
printf '{"plugins":{"entries":{}}}\n' >"$OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH"

complete=true

# Why the last OpenClaw command failed, in OpenClaw's words: the error of its
# JSON output, or the reason it printed.
reason() {
  why=$(jq -r '.error.message? // empty' "$output" 2>/dev/null)
  [ -n "$why" ] || why=$(sed -n 's/^\[openclaw\] Reason: //p' "$errors" | tail -n 1)
  [ -n "$why" ] || why=$(grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' "$errors" | tail -n 1 | cut -c1-300)
  printf '%s' "${why:-no reason given}"
}

# Report an OpenClaw step that failed, and leave the home unmarked.
failed() {
  log "could not $1: $(reason); the next start tries again"
  complete=false
}

# Run one OpenClaw command, and report it when it fails.
openclaw_step() {
  description=$1
  shift
  "$@" >"$output" 2>"$errors" && return 0
  failed "$description"
  return 1
}

# Whether OpenClaw's databases mention text, read as bytes: a cheap test that
# spares the OpenClaw CLI in homes the helper never signed in. The shared
# state database holds the secret store and the main agent's auth profiles;
# the agent's own database holds the profiles doctor imported. Deleted rows
# stay in the bytes until a database is compacted.
database_mentions() {
  for file in "$state"/state/openclaw.sqlite "$state"/state/openclaw.sqlite-wal \
    "$state"/agents/*/agent/openclaw-agent.sqlite "$state"/agents/*/agent/openclaw-agent.sqlite-wal; do
    if [ -f "$file" ] && grep -aqF -- "$1" "$file"; then
      return 0
    fi
  done
  return 1
}

# The secret-store entries the device login keeps the token in.
copilot_store_entries() {
  openclaw secrets store list --json >"$output" 2>"$errors" &&
    jq -e 'type == "array"' "$output" >/dev/null 2>&1 &&
    jq -r --arg prefix "$store_prefix" '.[] | .name | select(startswith($prefix))' "$output"
}

# Replace a file with what a filter makes of it, keeping the file private.
rewrite() {
  target=$1
  shift
  temp=$(mktemp "$target.tmp.XXXXXX") || return 1
  if "$@" <"$target" >"$temp" 2>/dev/null && chmod 600 "$temp" && mv -f "$temp" "$target"; then
    return 0
  fi
  rm -f "$temp"
  return 1
}

without_token_variables() {
  grep -Ev "$env_keys"
  # 1 only means that no other line is left.
  [ $? -le 1 ]
}

# Profile files keep the profiles under "profiles" or, the oldest, at the top.
without_profile() {
  jq --arg id "$profile" '
    if type != "object" then .
    elif (.profiles | type) == "object" then .profiles |= del(.[$id])
    elif has("profiles") then .
    else del(.[$id]) end'
}

signed_in=false
if database_mentions "$profile" || database_mentions "$store_prefix"; then
  signed_in=true
fi

# A removed entry is only marked deleted, and OpenClaw keeps its value for 30
# days: overwrite every value first. The profile and the entries go only once
# that worked, as logging the profile out may remove the entry it refers to.
store_ready=true
overwritten=" "
if database_mentions "$store_prefix"; then
  if entries=$(copilot_store_entries); then
    for name in $entries; do
      if openclaw_step "overwrite the secret-store entry $name" \
        openclaw secrets store set "$name" --kind secret --value-file - <<EOF
retired
EOF
      then
        overwritten="$overwritten$name "
      else
        store_ready=false
      fi
    done
  else
    failed "list the secret store"
    store_ready=false
  fi
fi

if [ "$store_ready" = true ] && database_mentions "$profile"; then
  # Among other reasons, OpenClaw refuses an auth store that holds no profile
  # while earlier profile files wait for doctor, when it is turned off.
  if openclaw models auth list --agent main --json >"$output" 2>"$errors" &&
    jq -e '.profiles | type == "array"' "$output" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if jq -e --arg id "$profile" 'any(.profiles[]; .id == $id)' "$output" >/dev/null &&
      openclaw_step "remove the $profile auth profile" openclaw models auth logout "$profile" --agent main --yes; then
      log "removed the $profile auth profile"
    fi
  else
    failed "list the auth profiles"
  fi
fi

if [ "$store_ready" = true ] && [ "$overwritten" != " " ]; then
  if entries=$(copilot_store_entries); then
    for name in $entries; do
      case "$overwritten" in
        *" $name "*) ;;
        *) continue ;;
      esac
      if openclaw_step "remove the secret-store entry $name" openclaw secrets store rm "$name" --yes; then
        log "removed the secret-store entry $name"
      fi
    done
  else
    failed "list the secret store"
  fi
fi

# Rewrite the databases so that no deleted row keeps the token's bytes, also
# after an earlier start removed the rows but not their bytes.
if [ "$signed_in" = true ]; then
  openclaw_step "compact the shared state database" openclaw doctor --state-sqlite compact
  if [ -f "$state/agents/main/agent/openclaw-agent.sqlite" ]; then
    openclaw_step "compact the agent database" openclaw doctor --session-sqlite compact --session-sqlite-agent main
  fi
fi

env_file=$state/.env
if [ -f "$env_file" ] && grep -Eq "$env_keys" "$env_file"; then
  if rewrite "$env_file" without_token_variables; then
    log "removed the GitHub token from $env_file"
  else
    log "could not rewrite $env_file; the next start tries again"
    complete=false
  fi
fi

# Profile files of earlier versions, and the copies doctor archived after
# importing them.
for file in "$state"/agents/*/agent/auth-profiles.json "$state"/agents/*/agent/auth-profiles.json.migrated-*; do
  [ -f "$file" ] || continue
  grep -qF "\"$profile\"" "$file" || continue
  if rewrite "$file" without_profile; then
    log "removed the $profile profile from $file"
  else
    log "could not rewrite $file; the next start tries again"
    complete=false
  fi
done

if [ "$complete" = true ] && ! touch "$marker"; then
  log "could not mark $state as done; the next start runs again"
fi
exit 0
data.retire-direct-model-auth.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
# Licensed under the MIT License.

# Native Sandbox init runs after doctor, which may import older auth profiles.
# Never print profile contents or CLI errors, which may include credentials.
set -eu
if [ "${1:-}" = "--help" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "Retire saved OpenClaw model auth before starting a native Sandbox."
  exit 0
fi

fail() {
  printf 'retire-direct-model-auth: %s; refusing to start the Agent\n' "$1" >&2
  exit 1
}

state=${OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR:-$HOME/.openclaw}
[ -d "$state" ] && [ ! -L "$state" ] || fail "state directory unavailable"
for directory in "$state/state" "$state/agents" "$state"/agents/* "$state"/agents/*/agent; do
  [ ! -L "$directory" ] || fail "unsupported auth directory link"
done
for directory in "$state"/agents/*; do
  if [ -d "$directory/agent" ] && [ "${directory##*/}" != main ]; then
    fail "additional Agent model stores are unsupported by the native MVP"
  fi
done
for file in "$state"/state/openclaw.sqlite* \
  "$state"/agents/*/agent/openclaw-agent.sqlite* "$state"/agents/*/agent/auth-profiles.json*; do
  [ ! -L "$file" ] || fail "unsupported auth store link"
done
scratch=$(mktemp -d) || fail "could not create scratch directory"
trap 'rm -rf "$scratch"' 0
output=$scratch/output
errors=$scratch/errors
export OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH="$scratch/openclaw.json"
printf '{"plugins":{"entries":{}}}\n' > "$OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH"

list_profiles() {
  openclaw models auth list --agent main --json > "$output" 2> "$errors" ||
    fail "could not list model auth profiles"
  jq -e '.profiles | type == "array" and all(.[];
    (.id | type) == "string" and (.id | test("^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.:@/+-]*$")))' \
    "$output" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "invalid model auth profile list"
}

list_profiles
profiles=$(jq -r '.profiles[].id' "$output") || fail "could not parse model auth profiles"
while IFS= read -r profile; do
  [ -n "$profile" ] || continue
  openclaw models auth logout "$profile" --agent main --yes > "$output" 2> "$errors" ||
    fail "could not remove model auth profile"
done <<EOF
$profiles
EOF

for directory in "$state"/agents/*; do
  for file in "$directory"/agent/auth-profiles.json "$directory"/agent/auth-profiles.json.migrated-*; do
    [ -e "$file" ] || continue
    [ -f "$file" ] || fail "invalid legacy auth profile"
    temp=$(mktemp "$file.tmp.XXXXXX") || fail "could not create auth profile replacement"
    if jq -e 'if type != "object" then error("invalid profiles")
      elif has("profiles") then
        if (.profiles | type) != "object" then error("invalid profiles")
        else .profiles = {} end
      else {} end' "$file" > "$temp" 2>/dev/null &&
      chmod 600 "$temp" && mv -f "$temp" "$file"; then
      :
    else
      rm -f "$temp"
      fail "could not clear legacy auth profiles"
    fi
  done
done

list_profiles
jq -e '.profiles | length == 0' "$output" >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
  fail "model auth profiles remain"

# Repeat compaction on restart, including after an earlier partial failure.
if [ -n "$profiles" ] || [ -f "$state/state/openclaw.sqlite" ]; then
  openclaw doctor --state-sqlite compact > "$output" 2> "$errors" ||
    fail "could not compact shared state"
fi
if [ -f "$state/agents/main/agent/openclaw-agent.sqlite" ]; then
  openclaw doctor --session-sqlite compact --session-sqlite-agent main > "$output" 2> "$errors" ||
    fail "could not compact agent state"
fi
printf 'retire-direct-model-auth: model auth profiles retired\n' >&2

#!/bin/sh
# Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
# Licensed under the MIT License.

# session-logger — Tail agent session/audit logs to stdout.
#
# Each JSONL line is a complete audit record (user input, assistant output,
# tool calls, tool results). Writing to stdout lets Container Insights
# (Azure Monitor) capture everything via ContainerLogV2.
#
# Runs as a sidecar container with the PVC mounted read-only.

set -e

AGENT_TYPE="${AGENT_TYPE:-hermes}"
SCAN_INTERVAL="${SCAN_INTERVAL:-30}"
MAX_FILES="${MAX_FILES:-50}"

if [ "$AGENT_TYPE" = "hermes" ]; then
  LOG_FILE="/home/vibe/.hermes/logs/gateway.log"
  echo "[session-logger] Starting Hermes gateway log tail (scan interval: ${SCAN_INTERVAL}s)"
else
  SESSIONS_BASE="/home/vibe/.openclaw/agents"
  echo "[session-logger] Starting OpenClaw session JSONL logger (scan interval: ${SCAN_INTERVAL}s, max files: ${MAX_FILES})"
fi

# Clean up all child processes on exit to prevent orphaned tail processes
# that would keep consuming memory after the main loop restarts.
cleanup() {
  kill 0 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT TERM INT

while true; do
  if [ "$AGENT_TYPE" = "hermes" ]; then
    if [ ! -f "$LOG_FILE" ]; then
      sleep "$SCAN_INTERVAL"
      continue
    fi

    tail -n 0 -F -- "$LOG_FILE" &
    TAIL_PID=$!
    while kill -0 "$TAIL_PID" 2>/dev/null; do
      sleep "$SCAN_INTERVAL"
    done
    wait "$TAIL_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    sleep "$SCAN_INTERVAL"
    continue
  fi

  # Find active session JSONL files modified in the last 24 hours.
  # Skips archived .reset.* files and stale sessions to limit open file
  # descriptors and polling overhead as session history grows.
  # Cap at MAX_FILES most-recently-modified files to bound memory usage from
  # tail's inotify watches while ensuring new sessions are always picked up.
  files=$(find "$SESSIONS_BASE" -path "*/sessions/*.jsonl" ! -name "*.reset.*" -mtime -1 -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -n "$MAX_FILES" | cut -d' ' -f2- | sort)

  if [ -z "$files" ]; then
    sleep "$SCAN_INTERVAL"
    continue
  fi

  file_count=$(echo "$files" | wc -l)
  echo "[session-logger] Tailing ${file_count} session file(s)"

  # Follow from current end of file — no replay of history on (re)start.
  # -q suppresses "==> filename <==" headers that would break the JSONL stream.
  # -- prevents filenames starting with - from being parsed as options.
  # Restrict splitting to newlines and disable globbing so paths with spaces
  # or glob characters are handled safely while still running a single tail.
  old_ifs=$IFS
  IFS='
'
  set -f
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
  set -- $files
  tail -q -n 0 -F -- "$@" &
  TAIL_PID=$!
  set +f
  IFS=$old_ifs

  # Periodically check for new session files; restart tail when set changes.
  while kill -0 "$TAIL_PID" 2>/dev/null; do
    sleep "$SCAN_INTERVAL"
    new_files=$(find "$SESSIONS_BASE" -path "*/sessions/*.jsonl" ! -name "*.reset.*" -mtime -1 -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -n "$MAX_FILES" | cut -d' ' -f2- | sort)
    if [ "$new_files" != "$files" ]; then
      echo "[session-logger] Session file set changed, restarting tail"
      kill "$TAIL_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
      break
    fi
  done

  wait "$TAIL_PID" 2>/dev/null || true

  # Backoff before restarting to avoid tight loop if tail fails immediately
  # (e.g., too many open file descriptors or transient FS issues).
  sleep "$SCAN_INTERVAL"
done
